messages:
marie nguyen: Hey — I received an org invite email but when I try to accept GitHub shows an SSO error. I already turned on 2FA. who should I ping to get this fixed? :wave:

devops-bot: @marie nguyen It looks like the invite is tied to SSO enforcement. Can you paste the exact error message? Also confirm the email on your GitHub account matches the invite address. :mag:

marie nguyen: Error dialog says: `You must be authorized by your organization to access this account via SAML SSO.` I have the invite sent to my personal GitHub (marie-ng). The org invite email was to my work email.

samira patel: @marie nguyen ah yeah that's the common mismatch. If the invite was to your work email you need to accept from the GitHub account that has that email attached. You can either add the work email to your existing GitHub account or ask ops to resend to your personal handle.

patrick o'leary: @marie nguyen I can resend to marie-ng. Which do you prefer? Also FWIW we require SSO enforced + 2FA for org membership.

marie nguyen: Sorry — I'd rather keep everything under marie-ng. I just added the work email to my GitHub and verified it. Trying to accept now...

marie nguyen: Still hitting the same SSO dialog. Copying exact console error: ```
Request to https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/invitations/12345 returned 403
{"message":"Must use SAML SSO to access this organization","documentation_url":"https://docs.github.com/orgs/"}
```

jordan lee: @patrick o'leary can you check the SSO provision for marie-ng? Might need to allow that account in the IdP mapping.

patrick o'leary: On it. I see the invite record tied to marie.work@redwood.com. I reissued an invite to marie-ng (1758203405). Try that one.

devops-bot: Invite reissued: https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/invitation — sent to marie-ng. Also note: if you still see SSO prompt you may need to sign out and back into GitHub after adding the work email + verifying.

marie nguyen: Accepted! 🎉 Thanks everyone. Quick follow-up: can someone add me to the runtime-team and give write access to repo redwood/runtime?

jordan lee: Added you to team: runtime-engineers and granted repo write on redwood/runtime (1758203550). You should see access in a few minutes.

marie nguyen: I can clone now, everything looks good. Thanks for the quick help :raised_hands:

patrick o'leary: Heads-up: onboarding doc with step-by-step is at https://docs.redwood.dev/onboarding/github-setup — includes screenshots and common SSO issues.

marie nguyen: Awesome — bookmarking that.

samira patel: Welcome aboard again, Marie! If you run into any other perms weirdness ping #eng-infra. :tada:
